source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The sergeant at arms is directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the impeachment court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator Judge Erwin Tulfo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Let's bow our heads down.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: I

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: pray today is from 1 Corinthians chapter 13 verses 1 to 7. If I could speak all the languages of the earth and of the angels but did not love others, I would only be a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal. If I had the gift of prophecy and if I understood all God's secret plans and possessed all knowledge, and if I had such faith that I could move mountains but did not love others, I would be nothing. If I gave everything I have to the poor and even sacrificed my body, I could boast about it. But if I don't love others, I would have gained nothing. Love is patient and kind. Love is not jealous or boastful or proud or rude. It does not demand its own way. It is not irritable. And it keeps on no record of being wrong. It does not rejoice about injustice, but rejoices whenever the truth wins out. Love never gives up, never loses faith. It's always hopeful and endures through every circumstance. This we ask of you, Almighty God. Amen.

turns.text: Opo. Sa palagay po ba ninyo, hindi kayo naipit dito? Sa pagpunta po nyo dito?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Hindi po, Your Honor, because ako po ay sumunod sa...

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Sa

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: experience ko po dito, laging nagbibigay ng suggestion.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: yung mga agency sa amin. Sa palagay niyo po ba may dapat tayong amendahan sa batas ng AMLAC patungkol sa confidentiality?

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: May sasuggest niyo po ba sa amin na amendahan nito para hindi po kayo parang niluluto dyan sa loob? Katulad kahapon.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Ano naman po, ginagawa ko lang po yung trabaho ko, Your Honor. Pero salamat po. Your Honor, nahitay ko na rin po yung opportunity. Meron po kasi yung mga pending AMLA bills po. So, ito po kasi ay requirement po sa international community. Pero to connect lang po dun sa tanong nyo po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Meron po

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: kaming provision po dun na of course yung confidentiality extend din po dun sa mga tao that we

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: are...

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: So sumasang-ayon po kayo?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Meron po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Ako naman po. Ako po

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: ay hindi abogado, pero ako po ay criminology graduate. Doon naman po ako bumabagsak sa law enforcement. Opo, kasi sa amin, merong apat na bagay. Una, inquiry, investigation, evaluation, then conclusion. Kayo po sa AMLC, nasa na po kayo doon? Nag-inquiry? Parang tapos na po kayo kasi sinasabi nyo kanina.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Okay, second round na lang po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may wind up your question.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Ah, pwede po. Salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Kasi po, narinig ko kanina, nandun na kayo sa investigation. Tama po ba? Natapos po ba yung investigation?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Hindi ko po masagot, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: O ano

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: lang po yung nasa records po, na nasabit po na?

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Opo, kasi na malinaw kanina, parang nasabi niyo po, nasa point pa lang ng investigation. Kasi kanina parang nabasa niyo po doon investigation?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Nung

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: sinopina po kami yung as of the time of the supina po sa amin ng court, eto po yung mga records na naka-include po in relation po doon sa STRs at CTRs po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: investigation po? Wala pa po kayo sa evaluation and conclusion? Kasi parang ang alam ko po sa AMLC, pagka meron na kayong conclusion, pwede nyo nang i-freeze yung assets, di ba po?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Hindi ko po masagot, Your Honor, any other action po na wala po or hindi po namin na-submit or wala po dito. Hindi po po ma-testify po, Your Honor. Hindi

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: ko

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: po ma-disclose po, Your Honor, hindi po siya kasama dun sa kung ano po yung nandito po. Pero

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: andyan po, investigation. Nabasa ko kanina, narinig ko, sinabi niyo, investigation eh.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Oo po, yung mga documents po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Nasa pangalawa pa lang, wala pang evaluation, wala pang conclusion.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly clarify, you cannot divulge. Hindi mo pwedeng ilahat.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Apo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kung meron o wala.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Apo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kasi hindi yun sa clown ng sinapina.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Hindi po yun sa clown ng supina at meron din po mga rules po na hindi po namin na nagbabawalan po kami i-disclose po. Alimbawa po yung nabanggit ko po kahapon yung bank inquiry rules ng Court of Appeals. Pag po nag-file po kami ng bank inquiry rules, bank inquiry po sa Court of Appeals, may nakalagay po na provision doon na we cannot disclose it. If we disclose it, that would constitute Contempt of Court. So yung may mga ganun po na legal impediment or maharang sa akin legally to disclose po. So we cannot disclose po. Una po, ito lang po yung na-include po sa supina. Then mayroon po mga rules, laws, other rules po that we consider po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Ang tanong ko lang po, simple lang kabayan, yung po bang hawak yung papel ay ano po yan ba? Ano po yung nasupina sa inyo?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Ang sinupina po sa amin, Your Honor,

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Kanina may nabasa po kayo parang investigation yung sinagit niyo kay Senator Erwin Tulfo?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Yes, Your

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Honor. What we submitted po are...

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Covered transaction reports, suspicious transaction reports on VP Duterte at Atty. Carpio, summary report on VP Duterte with a barcode, financial intelligence report on VP Duterte

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: with

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: AMLC reference, financial investigation report at Atty. Carpio, and confidential information sharing, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Okay po. Hanggang doon na lang po yung sinasabi niyo. Bali, ang tanong ko lang po kasi, sumusunod po ba kayo doon sa apat?

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Inquiry? Investigation? Evaluation and conclusion. Yun lang naman po. Wala naman po kung ibang tinatanong. Kung sumusunod po, hindi po... Kasi lahat po, lahat ng klase ng law enforcement, sa buong mundo, yun po ang dinadaana. Inquiry, investigation, conclusion, evaluation and conclusion. Yun lang naman po.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Proceso po kami, maari pong kahawig po nun pero hindi ko po alam exactly kung ano po yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Okay na po, kahawig na po yun.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Maari pong kahawig nung ano po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Sa ano na lang po, ito parang manifestation na lang po itong akin na ginoon po po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Opo, sana po maasabi lang po dun sa ating mga kasama na tutal hindi naman po nabanggit dito yung tungkol sa tapang at malasakit. Hinihingi ko po na huwag naman po kaming madamay lahat kasi kasama kami dyan eh. Hindi naman po yan nabanggit dito sa Korte, binanggit po yan ni former Senator Trillanes sa hindi sa Korting ito. So, hinihingi ko lang po sa mga kasama ko na pagka generalize po natin yan na tapang at malasakit, kasama po kami dyan. Wala po ako natanggap na pera kahit nasihin ko sa mga in-check. Yun lamang po. Maraming salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Chair declares our lunch recess.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Ronel, naunawaan po ninyo na patuloy kayo magbibigyan ng inyong testimonya base sa naunan niyo pong pinanumpaan kahapon.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Naunawaan po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kunti na lang

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: ito tulad ng sinabi ko kanina, Atty. Ronel. We are on the second round of interjections by Senator Judges. While we are awaiting, apologies, I'm sound present. While we are waiting, Senator Pia Cayetano, if she will avail of the second round, Chair would like to recognize Senator Judge Sotto.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: may proceed, sir, when you're ready. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer, but I will probably no longer avail of the second round. Some of the questions that I wanted to ask were asked by my colleagues earlier. Perhaps just a...

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Sabihin hindi ako. Baka sabihin hindi ako impartial.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Sotto. Or I don't know if I should say thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thanks from Attorney Ronel. It shortens his time on the witness stand. Senator Judge Hontiveros is next.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, ma'am, when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Oh nga pala, Ronel, kumain ka na. Kumain ka.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Basta nagagahan ka kanina. Senator Judge Risa, you may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Atty. Buenaventura.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Yes

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: po, Your Honor, Senator Judge.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Magandang hapon po.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Magandang hapon po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Tama po ba na yung essence nga ng money laundering ay precisely gusto pong itago ang pinanggalingan ng maruming pera?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Tama po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kaya po tawag po natin dun ay paglalaba.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: In Tagalog po, sa pagkaintindi ko po, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: yung 319 million pesos na remittances mula sa China ay yung lamang pong inireport sa AMLC. Ibig sabihin, pwede bang mas malaki pa ang pinadalang pera mula sa China sa mga kumpanya? Tama po ba yun?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Your Honor, hindi ko po masabi pero ang nakita lang po namin ay kung ano lang po nasa records, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kung ano yung nasa records dahil yun ang mga iniulat sa inyo bilang either suspicious or covered transaction records.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Kung meron pa man po na wala doon, hindi po namin makikita po yun, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay. Tapos, well, ito pong 319 million pesos mula sa China. Doon sa ang AMLC reports, hindi po naman yun yung paulit-ulit na pag-rollover ng time deposits, di po ba?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Yung nasa table 5 po namin, hindi po siya time deposit po, Your Honor. Ito po ay base po doon sa letter ng prosecution asking for the inward remittances po. So, nung hinahanap, nung ginawa po namin yung tabular summary po, Tinignan po namin kung anong code yung pertaining to inward remittances. At yung po yung ginamit po namin dito, Your Honor. So hindi po siya at unique transaction po siya. So magkakaiba po ito. Hindi po siya yung rollover po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So magkakaiba po. Unique at hindi pare-pareho yung sinasabing rollover ng time deposits at yung namang masasabing remittances.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: As far as in our records. As we understood it, Your Honor, yes po. As

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: you understand your records.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Eh yung, yung milyones po na di umano'y galing kay Samuel Uy, hindi rin naman po yun rollover ng mga time deposits, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Your Honor, apologies po, I can't specifically recall po yun.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: On that one po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Then, Nabanggit din po na may ilang suspicious transaction reports na di umano may connection sa drug trafficking. Ayon sa reports nyo, sino-sino pong mga tao di umano ang involved sa mga reported transactions na yon?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Your Honor, apologies po, hindi ko po maalala unless I'll be confronted with the record. Apologies po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright. So, hindi nyo rin po masasagot kung itanong ko na Magkano, di umano, ang transactions na may reports na related sa illegal drugs?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Wala lang po ako, wala po sa akin yung record, Your Honor. Hindi ko po masagot on the spot, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright, pero kung mapasakamay ninyo yung records, masasagot po nyo dito?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Ay, kung

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: hanapin lang po at maituro po, mababanggit ko po. Ah,

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: kaya nyo po bang hanapin during this trial day?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Kung yun po yung mga pinabasa po na hindi ko po maalala ko ng defense or ng prosecution po at maituturo lang po ulit yun base po dun sa kung anong pinabasa ko. Kung ma

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: -pinpoint naman po, masasabi ko naman po. Based on records lang din po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat, Atty. Buenaventura. Siguro, Mr. President, bago matapos itong trial day, baka pwede pong ipakita ulit sa witness yung record na yon para lang ma-on the record magkano di umano yung transactions na may reports kaugnay ng illegal drugs. Ulitin ko na lang po bago ako matapos, Atty. Buenaventura. So, ano pong mga aksyon kung mayroon na ang ginawa ng AMLC tungkol sa mga reports na yon?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Your Honor, hindi ko po maalala kung ano pong reports po lahat yun. Pero ang meron po kami at yun lang pong nasako po nung supina po natin na sinabit po, yung po mga financial intelligence report at financial investigation report po that we submitted po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright. And hindi nyo lang makonfirm sa amin kung itong mga reports ay bunga ng mga investigasyon ng council.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Hindi ko po ma-divulge po o bunyag po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright. May nabanggit din pong suspicious transaction reports na posibleng related sa graft and corruption. Magkano naman po di umano yung iyon?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Sa parehong kadahilanan po, Your Honor, unless makonfront po ulit ako nung document po so that I can answer that po, Your Honor. Pasensya na po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: It's alright po. Tulad nung halaga di umano ng reports related sa illegal drugs. Apo. Okay po. And then...

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Siguro huling tanong na sa ngayon. Yung halaga po pinagsama ng covered transaction reports at saka yung suspicious transaction reports kina VP Duterte at Atty. Carpio. Yun lamang po yung mga diumanong kaduda-duda o sakop sa cloud na ni-report sa AMLC. Hindi po yung kompletong record ng kanilang buong financial activity, inflows and outflows. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Your Honor, yung po na-report sa amin, yung covert transaction at saspecious transaction po. Kung meron nun po na hindi pa pasok doon sa dalawang uri ng transaction po, hindi po yun maire-report sa amin po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Right. And then, approaching that question from another angle, just winding up, Mr. Presiding Officer, kung meron namang pong gustong umiwas sa AMLC o sa pansin ng AMLC, pwede pong ibabasa 500,000 pesos ang halaga ng transaction, di po ba? Para hindi nga po mapansin ng AMLC.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Para hindi po ma-report?

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Para hindi ma

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: -report ng covered transactions.

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Tama po yun, Your Honor. Kasi po hindi po siya sasaklaw dun sa covered transaction report. Kaya lang po, meron din po isang circumstance po sa suspicious transaction report na kapag na based po dun sa over... circumstances po, it appears na the client is trying to structure his transaction so as not to be reported, subject of the reporting under the law, matitreat naman po siya. Hindi po as covered transaction, kundi po suspicious po. So pero, yun nga po, subject din po yung sa checking din po ng covered person po. So makikita pa rin po, nare-report naman din po yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay. So kahit pa po maiwas sa pansin ng AMLC or ng covered person bilang covered transaction report. Kung may mapansin pong circumstance na parang sinusubukang i-structure yung transactions, pwede pa rin pong masakop ng isang suspicious transaction report. Alright. Marami salamat po muli, Atty. Buenaventura. Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you, Sen. Judge Rison Tivero. Sen. Judge Raffy Tulfo is recognized. You may proceed, sir, when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Raffy, we shall have Senator Judge Lacson, thereafter Pangilinan, thereafter Villanueva, thereafter the Senate President, then finally Senator Judge Padilla.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay, ulitin ko yung tanong kanina. Hindi masyadong naging klaro sa akin at maybe sa inyo. Kailan kayo gumagawa ng investigasyon once na nalaman nyo na yung isang account ay may suspicious transaction?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Ano naman po yun, Your Honor? So, pag na-report po sa amin, meron lang po kaming prioritization po, given nga po na maliit lang po yung ahensya at yung resources po. So, namimili po kami base po dun sa mga kung ano po yung ipaprioritize na investigahan po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Hindi mention maliliit. Paano kung malalaki?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: accounts at malalaki ang transaksyon na perang lamabas-pasok. So, what do you do?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Kasama pa rin po yun sa prioritization po. Hindi naman po porket maliit or malaki yung pera. Yun lang po yung basihan namin. So, halimbawa po, if the crime po ay halimbawa ay terrorism financing, so, mas priority po namin yung kahit po mas maliit ng content dahil may national security concern po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kaya nga, what do you do? What kind of investigation do you conduct?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: After po noon, so, we analyze po the transactions po. and then at least dun sa initial transaction na analysis po kung meron po kaming makita na medyo that parang kailangan investigahan pa po ng mas detalyado i-endorse na po namin yun. sa kabilang grupo na mag-i-investigate na po talaga.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: At ano yung kabilang grupo?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Sa internal unit lang po yun sa AMLC.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kaya nga, and then anong

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: ginagawa ng internal unit?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Yung unit po na yun, sila po yung nag-conduct po ng full-blown investigation na po. Sila po yung kung kailangan po nilang kumuha pa ng mga detalye sa halimbawa po sa SEC, ng mga corporation. ng mga stockholders po kung kailangan po kumuha ng may ari-arian ba to sa land registration authority. Kung kailangan po mag-coordinate sa law enforcement kasi po kung nakita po na may predicate yung unlawful activity po ay halimbawa po kidnapping for ransom so we coordinate po with PNP po. So kasama na po yun doon. Bubuhin na po yung kaso po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay,

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: pag nagawa yun lahat na na nabanggit mo, anong sunod na course of action?

turns.speaker: AMLC Executive Director Atty. Ronel U. Buenaventura
turns.text: Ang gagawin po namin pag nagawa na po yun lahat, Kung kulang pa rin po at kailangan pong pa-open yung particular na banko po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo

turns.text: The records to be identified by this witness, limited by what is contained in the inventory of documents. that were signed by the parties on various dates were produced directly by land bank which has natural and regular custody of them pursuant to the subpoenas issued by the court. They were officially delivered to the court without passing through an interested party or private intermediary. The clerk recorded, inventoried, safeguarded, and reproduced the submissions for use in these proceedings. Taken together, the institutional returns to the subpoenas, the documented receipt, and protected custody of the source records, and the court supervised reproduction establishes the provenance of such records. The court is mindful. of Republic v. Marcos, GR 17-1701, which held that PCGG's collection and custody of private documents did not convert them into public records or without more authenticate them, particularly where only unauthenticated copies were presented.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hence, the Court relies not on custody alone but the records' direct production by the institutional custodians pursuant to the subpoena Their documented receipt and safekeeping by the clerk of court, their availability for inspection, and their court-supervised reproduction. Collectively, these circumstances establish records of provenance only, identity, and integrity, as well as fidelity of the copies. In addition, under Rule 4, Section 1 of the Rules and Evidence, an electronic document is regarded as equivalent of an original under the original document rule when its print When it is a printout of other or other output readable by sight or other means and shown to reflect the data accurately. To the extent that any record independently qualifies as an official record and is entitled to a presumption of regularity, that presumption is rebuttable and does not establish the truth or accuracy of every entry. Upon a specific substantial showing of fraud, falsification, material alteration, irregularity, incompleteness, palpable mistake, Unreliable method of preparation of breaking the chain of custody or lack of personal knowledge or material inconsistency with other evidence. The respondent or any other party may challenge the record's admission, seek the exclusion or limitation of the disputed entries, and request the appearance of appropriate custodian or other qualified witness as the case may be during cross-examination or during. The formal offer of evidence. In other words, we are not depriving the respondent of any of its available rights to question the authenticity of the documents but are simply trying to abbreviate the proceedings if there are no allegations nor claims of fraud, palpable mistake in the preparation of the documents in order to abbreviate the proceedings on these witnesses which are similarly situated.
